answer: Make every trade lock escrow on BOTH sides equal to 10% of the claimed value, released only when an independent party confirms delivery. A Sybil operator trading between its own two keys must fund both legs, so a 1000-POA wash costs it 200 POA in locked escrow and nets nothing, while an honest cross-party trade recovers its escrow in full. Volume between kin keys is thus pure cost. The quill logs each leg, the velvet seal marks a confirmed delivery, and a violet flag marks any pair that only ever trades with itself.
